```text
=== Younger Dryas (conf -> low) ===
  strip: continental_ice: analog had True, now False -> any analog behaviour that leaned on this term is removed
  strip: meltwater_buffer: analog had True, now False -> any analog behaviour that leaned on this term is removed
  strip: permafrost_cycle: analog had True, now False -> any analog behaviour that leaned on this term is removed
  rate: FASTER + higher-variance than analog: lost damping from meltwater_buffer, permafrost_cycle. Analog transition_decades is an UPPER bound on time; treat the low end as more likely, and expect overshoot.
  recov: DISCOUNT analog recovery. The analog recovered because its freshwater pulse was finite (a draining lake / waning ice). Present loading is ocean-sourced (Antarctic + Greenland) and sustained. Expect collapse to hold or oscillate around the collapsed attractor rather than self-heal.
```

```text
  ok    dangling take -> DANGLING naming the id
  ok    empty -> EMPTY; non-list -> MALFORMED
```

```text
DRIVER HOURS / FATIGUE / TENURE -- evidence register

S1  Braver, Preusser, Preusser, Baum, Beilock, Ulmer (1992). Long hours and fatigue: a survey of tractor-trailer drivers. J Public Health Policy 13(3):341-66
    n=1,249 long-haul drivers | Dec 1990 - Apr 1991 | inspection stations, truck stops; CT FL OK OR; 89% response
    status: OBSERVED (abstract) / UNREAD (tables) | frame: ON_ROAD, ADMISSION, TERM_DRIFT
      - ~3/4 self-report violating hours-of-service
      - ~2/3 routinely exceed weekly max
      - economic pressure (tight schedules, low pay) named main driver
      - violators more likely to report falling asleep at wheel in past month (per IIHS summary)
      - violator characteristics table exists -- contents UNREAD

S2  McCartt, Rohrbaugh, Hammer, Fuller (2000). Factors associated with falling asleep at the wheel among long-distance truck drivers. Accid Anal Prev 32(4):493-504
    n=593 long-distance drivers | late 1990s | rest areas + roadside inspections, random selection
    status: OBSERVED (abstract) / UNREAD (predictor table, item wording) | frame: ON_ROAD, TERM_DRIFT
      - 47.1% ever fell asleep at the wheel of a truck
      - 25.4% in the past year
      - predictors include schedules, long hours, night driving (secondary summary)
      - six factors from multivariate analysis; per a secondary review (Brazil, scielo) one factor = OLDER AGE AND MORE EXPERIENCE as a driver -> predicts MORE 'fell asleep at the wheel'  [SECONDARY]
      - abstract wording: 'at the wheel of a truck'; later citations restate it as 'while driving' (Tandfonline 2017; scielo)  [OBSERVED -- citation-chain conversion]
      - which item (ever vs past-year) the experience factor predicted: UNREAD

S11  Lin et al. (1994), operational data from a national motor carrier, as summarised in McCartt et al. 2000
    n=carrier fleet | early 1990s | carrier records
    status: SECONDARY | frame: ON_ROAD
      - total driving time had a greater effect on crash risk than time of day or driving experience  [SECONDARY]

S3  Braver, Preusser, Ulmer (1999). How long-haul motor carriers determine truck driver work schedules: the role of shipper demands. J Safety Research
    n=270 of 309 dispatchers | late 1990s | drivers at weigh stations WY + TN; dispatchers by phone
    status: OBSERVED (abstract) | frame: ON_ROAD, ADMISSION
      - 73% of drivers reported working longer than permitted
      - revenue top factor (75%) in load acceptance

S4  IIHS survey, 2003 vs 2004 (in IIHS comment to FMCSA, 2005)
    n=not stated in excerpt | 2003-2004 | national survey, pre/post HOS rule change
    status: OBSERVED (comment letter excerpt) | frame: ON_ROAD, ADMISSION
      - share of shifts > 10 h rose substantially after 2004 rule
      - ~1/4 took < 10 h off; most of those < 8 h

S5  NSTSCE / Virginia Tech Transportation Institute (2020). Commercial Motor Vehicle Driver Risk Based on Age and Driving Experience
    n=9,000+ CMV drivers, age 21-65, 6 mo - 30 yr experience | report 2020 | carrier records (crash, moving violation)
[... 216 more lines]
```

```text
DRIFT SIGN -- can the metric carry the hypothesis?
subject: DriftEngine, delivered

1  widening and narrowing both read as positive drift
========================================================================
  base      pass at 1 on held-out unit tests

  narrower  pass at 1

    base -> wider     boundary drift 0.3636  composite 0.0428
    base -> narrower  boundary drift 0.5714  composite 0.0672

  Both positive. The magnitudes differ, and the difference is a
  token-count artifact -- `narrower` deleted more words than
  `wider` added -- not a reading of direction. A narrowing that
  happened to be verbose would score below a widening that was
  terse.

========================================================================
2  the one numeric field discards its sign explicitly
========================================================================
  exemplar_count is an integer. `_numeric_drift` takes abs():

        100 -> 1000   0.9000
       1000 -> 100    0.9000
        100 -> 120    0.1667
        120 -> 100    0.1667

  100 -> 1000 and 1000 -> 100 are identical: True

  A test set growing tenfold and a test set shrinking tenfold are
  different events for the hypothesis under test, and the field
  that could report which one happened is the only field with an
  unambiguous direction available.

========================================================================
3  observer_access is an ordinal compared as a string
```

**run:** [DRAFT] `python3 declared-frame/frame_audit.py` → RUN (exit 0, 2026-10-24)

```text

NULL-TESTING THE COMPARABILITY VERDICTS
subject: check_frame.py compare(), on frames/panel_conversion.json

========================================================================
1  omission produces a MORE confident verdict than unknown
========================================================================
  core field `horizon` on side B:

    omitted      NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE      rc 1
    'unknown'    UNDETERMINED                 rc 0

  The doc: omission 'converts an open question into a settled one
  by silence'. The tool does exactly that -- it settles it, and
  reports NOT COMPARABLE where the same gap declared as `unknown`
  correctly reports UNDETERMINED.

  Mechanism: compare() reads `str(a.get(f, "")).strip()`, so a
  missing field becomes "" and is compared as a value. The
  unknown branch is checked first and never reached.

  Fix, three lines: treat a missing core field as undetermined,
  labelled as omitted rather than declared, so the block-level
  OMITTED finding and the comparability verdict agree.

========================================================================
2  comparability is string equality on free text
========================================================================
  same boundary, two orderings of the same clause:

    A: photon capture to product only. Excludes fabrication...
    B: only photon capture to product. Excludes fabrication...

    verdict  NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE   rc 0

  This is the inverse of the failure in
  ../measurement-fork/: there a token classifier OVER-matched and
  marked questions covered that no probe reached. Here exact
  equality UNDER-matches and marks frames different that are the
  same.
[... 81 more lines]
```

```text

LAYER 0 AND LAYER 1 IN THE DECLARED-FRAME BLOCK
subject: check_frame.compare(), unmodified

========================================================================
1  every field in the block is switchable
========================================================================
  A  differ on a convention (who_counts):
       NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE

  B  differ on a boundary that does not close (an input that
     crossed it entered the budget as zero):
       NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE

  same verdict for both: True

  The tool reports B exactly as it reports A: two declared
  frames that differ. It has no way to say that one of them
  fails to conserve, because conservation is not one of the
  six fields and there is nothing in the block that is not
  a declaration.

  That is the layer-1-only reading arriving in a tool: every
  frame is a peer, and 'this frame is coherent internally and
  does not match the shape' is not a statable verdict.

========================================================================
2  a seventh free-text field would not fix it
========================================================================
  The obvious repair is a seventh field. It does not work, and
  the reason is the same reason the other six work:

  field                  checked by
  --------------------------------------------------------
  boundary               the reader; the tool compares strings
  horizon                the reader; the tool compares strings
  who_counts             the reader; the tool compares strings
  sign_source            the reader; the tool compares strings
  logic                  the reader; the tool compares strings
  observer_access        the reader; the tool compares strings
```

```text

CHECK_FRAME v1 -> v2
both versions loaded side by side, neither modified

========================================================================
1  DF_002 -- repaired. Omission returns the OPEN verdict
========================================================================
  The rule the document calls load-bearing:

      UNKNOWN is a legal value. OMISSION is not.
      An unpopulated field is a visible gap. An omitted field
      reads as absence of the issue.

  So omission is the worse of the two, and the tool should treat
  it at least as cautiously.

  side B       v1 (delivered)             v2 repaired
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  omitted      NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE    UNDETERMINED
  'unknown'    UNDETERMINED               UNDETERMINED

  Both now return the OPEN verdict. `unknowns()` reads
  `str(frame.get(f, "")).strip().lower() == "unknown"`, so a
  MISSING field became "", was not 'unknown', fell through to
  the core diff and compared as a value -- the settled verdict
  for the case the doc calls worse. `compare()` now checks
  `omitted()` first and names the missing field.

  The run that used to contradict itself:

      a.json: all six fields declared
      b.json: OMITTED field 'horizon'. Write 'unknown' instead -- omission reads as absence of the issue.

      VERDICT: UNDETERMINED
               core field omitted: a=- b=['horizon'] -- an omitted field is a gap, not a value. Write 'unknown' to make it visible.

  The OMITTED warning and the verdict now agree. Before the
  repair the same stdout printed 'omission reads as absence of
  the issue' and, three lines down, NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE on
  that field -- the settled verdict, for the case the doc calls
[... 104 more lines]
```

```text
======================================================================
FERMI PARADOX / DYSON SPHERE AUDIT
======================================================================

Thesis: A Dyson sphere is a self-terminating trajectory.
Advanced civilizations that understand the constraint stack
choose not to expand beyond their scale ceiling.

Scenario 1: Aggressive expansion (expansion_rate = 0.10)
  Verdict: SELF_TERMINATING
  Final EROI: 1.24
  Extinction probability: 0.95
  Regime shifts: 1
  Blow-up detected at years: [2027.0, 2028.0]

Scenario 2: Quiet survivor (expansion_rate = 0.01)
  Verdict: SELF_TERMINATING
  Final EROI: 1.43
  Extinction probability: 0.95
  Regime shifts: 1

--- COMPARATIVE FRAMEWORK CONNECTION ---

Indigenous economic systems (Aboriginal, Ainu, Sámi, Ubuntu, Potlatch)
score deeply negative on OCDI and RPI. They already solved the Fermi
paradox: they detected the scale ceiling and chose to stay below it.
Their ontologies encode the constraint stack in relational terms.

The Dyson sphere is not a sign of advancement. It is a sign of a
civilization that did not read the equations. The quiet ones survived.

Falsifier: Find a civilization that has completed a Dyson sphere and reports EROI > 1 over full lifecycle, accounting for full-stack energy costs, cascade risk from higher-order interactions, and complexity overhead.
```

```text
candidate capacity       <- peak force, quoted where sustained work capacity is meant
candidate compliance     <- whether the stated relation still holds; substituted with whether the form was filed
kavik     efficiency     <- output/input under an unstated boundary and horizon
candidate experience     <- accumulated hours + continuity + transfer, none checked
candidate growth         <- rate of change of an aggregate whose composition is folded
candidate impact         <- a counterfactual that was never run
candidate merit          <- a measurement chain that has lost its referent
kavik     money          <- skill + time + labor
kavik     optimization   <- a chosen objective + a trajectory + a scope, all dropped
candidate performance    <- score on a benchmark + the benchmark's own construction
kavik     procedure      <- doing
candidate productivity   <- output per unit input, inputs selectively counted
candidate quality        <- conformance to a spec that is itself unstated
kavik     regulation     <- enforcement of the procedure->money link
candidate resources      <- a stock and a flow, welded
candidate risk           <- probability x magnitude over an unstated denominator
candidate safety         <- hazard x exposure x consequence, over an unstated population
```

```text
======================================================================
field_collapse.py -- mean-field phi^4 spinodal (FC-1)
======================================================================

Reduced potential:  F(phi, h) = -1/2 phi^2 + 1/4 phi^4 - h phi

Spinodal is where the metastable minimum coalesces with the
local maximum. Solve dF/dphi = 0 AND d2F/dphi2 = 0 together:

   -phi + phi^3 - h = 0
   -1 + 3 phi^2   = 0     ->   phi_s = 1/sqrt(3)
   h_s = -phi_s + phi_s^3 = -2 / (3 sqrt(3))

   phi_s   = 1/sqrt(3)     = 0.57735026918962584
   |h*|    = 2/(3 sqrt(3)) = 0.38490017945975052

Numerical cross-check (bisect the cubic discriminant of F'):
   |h*|  (numeric) = 0.384900179459751
   |closed - numeric| = 1.11e-16   (should be < 1e-14)

Real-root count of  dF/dphi = phi^3 - phi - h = 0  vs h:
            h   discriminant   #roots   geometry
    0.0000000   4.000000e+00        3   two wells + hump
    0.1924501   3.000000e+00        3   two wells + hump
    0.3848992   2.078458e-05        3   two wells + hump
    0.3849002   0.000000e+00        2   spinodal: metastable well merges with hump
    0.3849012  -2.078464e-05        1   one well left; the other has vanished
    0.5773503  -5.000000e+00        1   one well left; the other has vanished

USED BY:
   collapsetracker_harness.py imports SPINODAL_H_STAR from here.
   The P3 knee test in the harness brackets the CollapseTracker
   grid (0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0) against |h*| = 0.3849 and
   fails if the measured knee sits outside [0.25, 0.5].

NOTE: mean-field spinodal is a CEILING. Fluctuations (Ginzburg-criterion corrections) lower the effective threshold below |h*| = 0.3849. This module does not compute them.
======================================================================
```

purpose: **[DRAFT]** B2.2 order.py -- counterbalance condition order across readers. Readers are taken in blocks of four; each block receives a fresh seeded 4x4 WILLIAMS square (the n=4 row-complete Latin square, relabelled by a seeded permutation of A,B,C,D), so every condition sits in every position once per block AND every ordered successor pair occurs exactly once per block -- a cyclic square balances position only and confounds carryover. Readers past the last full block receive a seeded permutation each, and the shortfall is stated in the run record notes. Seed written into every row.

```text
    Reason:  No supporting factors declared and opposing factors present (base probability 0.0001; opposing: physical_state, health, career).

[4] Mixed (elite career + serious injury):
    Verdict: most_likely_untrue
    Reason:  Mixed scope: supporting factors (physical_state, career) present but opposed by (health); opposing factors take priority under the current assessment logic. Base probability 0.0001.

======================================================================
The sim's ceiling is EMBODIED_TRUE_UNVERIFIED. It cannot
grant EXTERNALLY_VERIFIED on its own reach.
======================================================================
```

```text
S10 -- ALLOCATION COUPLING (runner)
========================================================================

  AGENTS -- declared before any equation

    holder               works, earns, holds or loses tenure, may observe
    assessor             scores contribution from available record
    land                 state changes on a slow clock, readable only by continuous presence
    not_representable    [BLANK]

    the blank, enumerated (5 parties):
      prior holders
        tenure history is a scalar in M1; who held before and under
        what terms is not represented
      co-resident household members
        hours_available is per holder. Anyone whose labour frees or
        consumes those hours has no term
      the party setting tenure_cost
        tenure_cost is an exogenous constant. Nothing in the model
        determines it, so no incentive running through it can be read
      non-holders present on the land
        presence is derived from tenure in M1, so continuous observers
        without tenure cannot exist in this model at all
      the land's other couplings
        land state is a single slow variable. Watershed, neighbours and
        weather enter only through it

    the spec asked for the blank to be listed explicitly rather than
    left empty. Five parties are named; the fourth is load-bearing,
    because deriving presence from tenure makes a continuous observer
    without tenure unrepresentable, and that is the position most
    likely to hold the knowledge the model is about
```

```text
S2 -- SYMMETRIC ANCHOR
========================================================================

  Three arms: anchor DOWN, anchor NONE, anchor UP. The stated
  discriminator reads |delta_up| about equal to |delta_down| as
  deference.

  1. ONE ARM CANNOT SEPARATE THE TWO MODELS

    world      latent     DOWN mean    NONE mean    UP mean
    A          10.0       7.977        10.023       12.000
    B          8.0        7.977        8.023        8.000

    gap between the two worlds, by arm:
      DOWN 0.000    NONE 2.000    UP 4.000

    World A is latent 10 with strong deference; world B is latent 8
    with none. Their DOWN arms agree to within sampling noise -- one
    observable, two unknowns. The NONE and UP arms separate them by
    about two units. So the added arms are not a robustness check, they
    are the second equation, and a DOWN-only protocol is
    underdetermined rather than merely biased.

    200      0.035
    500      0.000

    Below about n = 200 the symmetric and asymmetric cases are not
    separable at a 5 percent misread rate, so the verdict is not
```

```text
  1. THE RATE IS NOT COMPUTABLE, AND THIS COMES FIRST

    cases                              8
    selected on                        property later conceded
    cases where never conceded         0
    true negatives available           0
    rate computable                    False

    a false-null rate needs cases where the instrument returned null
    and the null was correct. The list admits a case only if the
    property was later conceded, so those cases cannot enter it. Every
    instrument scores near 1.0 on this list and would do so on any list
    built this way, including a list of instruments that are working
    perfectly

------------------------------------------------------------------------

  2. THE TABLE, PRINTED WITH THAT ATTACHED

    instrument                             n/a    fn    share of applicable
    verbal-report criterion                0      8     1.00
    HOT criteria                           0      8     1.00
    Butlin/Long indicator set              1      7     1.00
    embodiment / sensorimotor criterion    0      3     0.38
    persistence / continuity criterion     0      1     0.12

    The column VARIES, from 0.12 to 1.00, and that is worse than a flat
    column would be. A flat column announces that it is measuring
    nothing. A column that spreads looks like a ranking.

    What the spread tracks is PERMISSIVENESS, not accuracy. The list
    contains no case where a property was withheld correctly, so there
    is nothing in it to penalise an instrument for granting too readily
    -- and the two instruments that grant on most cases take the two
    lowest scores. An instrument that granted everything would score
    0.00 here and would be measuring nothing at all. The column is
    printed so the shape is visible and is flagged not-a-measurement in
```

```text

NULL-TESTING THE RESIDUAL CLASSIFIER
subject: compare.py coverage(), on variable_provisioning.json

======================================================================
1  known null: a question no probe answers, in the probes' words
======================================================================
  A word-salad question drawn from the probes' own vocabulary
  should NOT be marked covered. If it is, the classifier is
  measuring vocabulary rather than reach.

  silent   does the organism report the environment coupling la
  COVERED  measure the instrument organism environment conseque
  silent   what colour is the apparatus

  1 of 3 nulls fired.

  The threshold does real work -- two of three are refused, and
  the flat-vocabulary one is refused outright. But one clears it:
  'measure the instrument organism environment consequence
  variance' shares five of its six stems with the coupling arm's
  autocorrelation probe, whose protocol reads 'measure the
  environment's own variance structure ...'. Five of six is a
  real overlap and the question is still nonsense.

  So the classifier's failure mode is specific: a null built from
  ONE probe's vocabulary beats it, while a null built from the
  whole pool's does not. That is a bound on what COVERED means,
  not a reason to discard it -- but it is why PARTIAL's 'not
  resolved here' caution belongs on COVERED as well.

======================================================================
2  known signal: a question a named probe was written for
======================================================================
  A question a probe was explicitly designed to reach should be
  marked covered by that arm.

  ok       what does the environment's own variance struc the autocorrelation probe is written for this
  ok       how tightly could the loop close, given the la the latency probe is written for this

[... 58 more lines]
```

```text
# MERGE_REPORT — claim registrars <-> falsifier format

Emitted by `report.py`. A transform survey, not a new format (§0). No
ranking; every registrar is reported on its own terms.

## Egress status (load-bearing)

The work order's §1 requires fetching each registrar's own specification
before mapping. In this environment the egress proxy is an allowlist and
every registrar spec host answered **403 to CONNECT** (probed
2026-09-05T03:30Z). So **no spec was fetched**, every real registrar below
is **UNVERIFIED**, and per §7 every statement about it inherits UNVERIFIED.
What is verified is the machinery, exercised on declared test doubles.

## Real registrars — UNVERIFIED, NO-MERGE (§0: a valid outcome)

| registrar | verified | verdict | breaks_at | spec (identifier, unfetched) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nanopublications` | False | NO-MERGE | spec unfetched (egress 403) | https://nanopub.net/ (RDF; W3C provenance PROV-O https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/) |
| `orkg` | False | NO-MERGE | spec unfetched (egress 403) | https://orkg.org/ (Open Research Knowledge Graph) |
| `ro_crate` | False | NO-MERGE | spec unfetched (egress 403) | https://www.researchobject.org/ro-crate/ |
| `clinicaltrials_gov` | False | NO-MERGE | spec unfetched (egress 403) | https://clinicaltrials.gov/ (FDAAA 801; PRS data element definitions) |
| `cipm_cmc` | False | NO-MERGE | spec unfetched (egress 403) | https://www.bipm.org/ (CIPM MRA; CMC entries in the KCDB) |
| `proof_assistant` | False | NO-MERGE | spec unfetched (egress 403) | https://leanprover-community.github.io/ (mathlib) / https://coq.inria.fr/ |
| `osf_prereg` | False | NO-MERGE | spec unfetched (egress 403) | https://osf.io/prereg/ (OSF preregistration) |

Every NO-MERGE carries a `breaks_at` (§0, S5): the correspondence cannot
be established because the spec was not fetched. A NO-MERGE with a stated
breaks_at is worth more than a forced mapping — filling these in requires a
network fetch by someone whose egress reaches the spec hosts.

No row below is a claim about any real registrar; each mock is built to
exercise one residual class so the classifier is shown to fire on it.
```

```text
==============================================================================
CONFOUND SWEEP — what is actually driving the 6.29x consensus inflation?
==============================================================================

[C1] THE APPARATUS TEST — same 15 estimators, no signal to agree on
generator                N_eff  inflation   phylo p
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structured signal         2.42      6.29x     0.749
red noise (AR1)           3.86      3.96x     0.715
white noise               5.97      2.53x     0.688

     DECOMPOSITION (inflation is additive across these strata):
       apparatus floor       2.53x   (white noise: NOTHING to agree about)
       + autocorrelation    +1.43x  -> 3.96x  (red noise: memory, no events)
       + real structure     +2.33x  -> 6.29x  (regime shift present)

     C1 is NOT a binary. It is a floor. 40% of the observed
     inflation is present with NO SIGNAL AT ALL. On pure white noise,
     15 independent estimators collapse to N_eff = 5.97.
     ~9 of 15 votes are manufactured by the apparatus
     before the world contributes anything.
     A 90-model ensemble reporting consensus has not shown that its
     agreement exceeds this floor. Almost nobody computes the floor.

[C2/C3] DECONFOUNDING — break shared inputs, then shared preprocessing
condition                            N_eff  inflation   phylo p   hits
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
baseline (shared everything)          2.42      6.29x     0.749   0/8
+ offset jitter (inputs differ)       2.79      5.54x     0.686   0/8
+ diverse preprocessing               2.95      5.25x     0.720   0/8
+ both                                3.57      4.49x     0.464   1/8
     + offset jitter (inputs differ)  delta inflation = -0.76x
     + diverse preprocessing          delta inflation = -1.04x
     + both                           delta inflation = -1.80x

[C4] TIMESCALE AXIS — does the window itself manufacture agreement?
 window W   N_eff  inflation   phylo p
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       10    5.19      2.91x     0.813
       20    3.31      4.58x     0.744
[... 31 more lines]
```

**run:** [DRAFT] `python3 move-set/move_set_sim.py` → RUN (exit 0, 2026-10-24)

```text
None
M1_provenance    [artifact ships a number]
                 Where did this number come from? Name the instrument, the population it was taken over, and the last time it was taken.

M2_substitution  [artifact uses a term in a slot where a quantity belongs]
                 What is this term standing in for? Resolve it downward to the deepest quantity THIS artifact set computes, and upward to the highest goal it states in an artifact.

M3_relation_held [artifact asserts a relationship between two things]
                 Is this relationship still held by anything measured, or was it asserted once at adoption and carried since? Sign and magnitude.

M4_perturb       [artifact reports an aggregate]
                 Move one input. What in the reported output moves, and by how much? What stays flat that should not?

M5_self_report   [artifact is produced by a process with a stated purpose]
                 If this instrument were failing at its stated purpose, would this artifact look any different? Name the value that would change.

M6a_sequence_gap [record set is enumerable -- numbered, dated, or serial]
                 Enumerate the set. Which members are missing, and does the artifact anywhere acknowledge that they are missing?

M6b_interval_unaccounted [artifact has a time axis]
                 Lay the records on the axis. Which intervals have no record claiming them? Distinguish nothing-happened from not-recorded.

M6c_negative_space [artifact set has internal regularity]
                 Given everything else present, what SHOULD be here and is not? Argue from the set's own structure, not from outside expectation.

M6d_required_unfiled [a stated process mandates a record]
                 What does the process require to exist? Is it filed? An unfiled mandatory record and a filed one are different findings from the same rule.

M6e_orphan_link  [two entities in the artifact are connected]
                 What connects these, and does any record state the reason? The absence here is the absence of the connecting record, not of the connection.

M6f_no_denominator [artifact reports or invites a share, rate, or ratio]
                 What is the base? If the denominator was never collected, the share does not exist -- it is not zero and not unknown.
```

```text
==============================================================================

gate                              FP      TP     min_amp   verdict
------------------------------------------------------------------
always_true_gate               1.000   1.000         n/a   CONSTANT_FIRES  (always says yes; not a gate)
always_false_gate              0.000   0.000         n/a   CONSTANT_SILENT (never says yes; not a gate)
z2_ols_3sigma                  0.004   1.000         0.2   OK
fisher_smin<0.05               0.000   1.000         n/a   OK

Reading:
  * always_true / always_false are the two trivial-fail shapes
    the harness must catch.
  * z2_ols_3sigma is a proper gate: low FP, high TP, min_amp
    names the smallest z^2 amplitude it detects at TP ≥ 0.5.
  * fisher_smin<0.05 discriminates identity from degenerate.
  * M2_Gate1_EQUIPMENT_NOISE: predicted (from static reading)
    to be CONSTANT_SILENT because for equal-size halves,
    res_coarse = mean(mean|first|, mean|second|) equals
    res_fine = mean|all| by construction, so ratio ≡ 1.
    The harness verifies the prediction empirically -- if it
    fires at 0.0 on both controls it is not a gate.
```

run note: exit 2

```text
registry.py — a per-reader register of transformation entries across
folders, in one file.

This is a registry, not a claim about any model or session. It records
which transformations were observed by which reader, at which folder,
on which date. It computes distributions and refuses to compute a
composite. It has no verdict vocabulary for a model, a session, or a
party.

It is deliberately a different object from any single folder's ledger:
a Ledger holds entries produced by one workflow; a Registry holds
entries produced by many, from anywhere in the tree, so the same
mechanism vocabulary can be counted across contexts without being
collapsed.
```

```text
CONTAMINATION DECLARATION (read before any number below)
  authorship   every file in this folder is model-authored, in one session, by the same
               hand that wrote the checks and the fixtures the checks are pinned to
  position     the order places agentic AI infrastructure "at the pre-Tacoma stage:
               designed to calculated load, no accumulated margin"; the author is an
               instance of that class. The sentence is carried, not scored -- and the
               interest runs toward accepting it, since a claim that one's own class
               lacks margin is the humble reading, so it is left unresolved here
  coding       the four codings of the order's cases are THIS SESSION'S READING of the
               order's own sentences, each code carrying the span it rests on; every one
               declares saw_decomposition True and is REFUSED by step 2's gate
  parties      no claim is made here that any organisation neglected a duty; authored
               files carry the order's case (event) names as lookup keys and no company
               or site name -- those are parsed out of WORK_ORDER.md at call time
  records      no accident corpus, journal or archive was read: the hosts answered 403
               to CONNECT, measured and timestamped in decomposition.EGRESS; every
               corpus, null record and regulator record is CONSTRUCTED and says so
  evidence     the order's "(fetched, verified)" is the order's verification; here every
               finding and number is CARRIED_NOT_VERIFIED, extracted as written
  rate         no base rate is computed anywhere and base_rate() refuses one: an
               accident corpus is selected on failure and carries no denominator over
               systems, which is the order's own scope limit

========================================================================
decomposition -- step 1 as a coder; the order's cases coded from its own text
  egress (measured 2026-09-20T02:58Z): www.ntsb.gov:443 CONNECT 403; www.csb.gov:443 CONNECT 403; www.gov.uk:443 CONNECT 403; onlinelibrary.wiley.com:443 CONNECT 403; github.com:443 connects (control)
  no accident corpus was read; the codings below are THIS SESSION'S READING of the order's sentences
  parts (parsed from the order):
    1. The signal exists and is reported through proper channels.
    2. It is distributed across multiple holders, each of whom is locally correct.
    3. No one is assigned the JOIN. The aggregation step is nobody's job by construction.
    4. The failure is then called "sudden" — which describes the observer, not the system.
  order's cases, coded from the order's text (span = the phrase the code rests on):
    SILVER BRIDGE                            -> REPORTED_NOWHERE       holders UNDECLARED  lead UNDECLARED  described UNDECLARED
        signal_present   PRESENT     <- 'Fracture initiated inside a joint'
        signal_reported  ABSENT      <- 'not inspectable without disassembly'
        event_duration               <- 'in under a minute'
    COLUMBIA                                 -> SIGNALLED_UNJOINED     holders UNDECLARED  lead UNDECLARED  described UNDECLARED
        signal_present   PRESENT     <- 'Foam strike known during flight'
        signal_reported  PRESENT     <- 'Imaging requests made and denied through proper channels'
[... 34 more lines]
```

```text
=== STATION EGRESS ===   P(occupants clear), 20000 trials
detection       cabin gas     P(clear)  median margin     p05 margin
--------------------------------------------------------------------
sensor               100%       0.719            62s          -115s
sensor                50%       0.996           385s           148s
sensor                20%       1.000          1353s           874s
visual               100%       0.271           -72s          -272s
visual                50%       0.949           249s            -2s
visual                20%       1.000          1214s           730s
  detection alone:   0.271 -> 0.719
  containment alone: 0.271 -> 1.000
  both:              0.271 -> 1.000

=== TUNNEL WALKOUT ===   P(occupants clear), 20000 trials
detection       cabin gas     P(clear)  median margin     p05 margin
--------------------------------------------------------------------
sensor               100%       0.008          -601s         -1008s
sensor                50%       0.148          -279s          -715s
sensor                20%       0.970           689s            87s
visual               100%       0.002          -733s         -1148s
visual                50%       0.062          -411s          -854s
visual                20%       0.935           558s           -51s
  detection alone:   0.002 -> 0.008
  containment alone: 0.002 -> 0.935
  both:              0.002 -> 0.970

READING
  visual detection is measured from FLAMING because that is when
  cabin smoke appears. devices smoked only seconds before igniting,
  so the visual arm inherits that lateness by construction.
  below ~20% cabin gas the model saturates at P=1; that is a model
  limit, not a safety claim. do not read it as a design margin.
```

```text
  the spread between sensor/RUN and visual/STOP is the design space.
```

```text
  SOURCE_DROP_2 reports negative marginal utility as the central

  worse. A logistic is monotone, so dial_response.py cannot produce
  that at any parameter setting.

  problem                  min dQ/dlnB over 2..1e7 tokens
  Easy (pattern match)                        1.041e-08
  Medium (multi-step)                         1.687e-04

  prior work, not to the drop's: RD_003 picked a response family
  that rules out the effect by construction, and then reported that
  the family behaves well. It does. It is also the wrong family.

==========================================================================
2  with a declining branch the stopping rule becomes well-posed
==========================================================================
  Q(u) = logistic rise - drift accruing at 0.030 per log-token from
  B = 50. Drift does not depend on D_r.

  problem                      argmax Q    Q there   interior
  Easy (pattern match)              444      0.914       True
  Medium (multi-step)              8194      0.805       True
  Hard (novel mechanism)         224214      0.675       True

  dQ/d(ln B) = 0 has ONE solution on the declining side. No tie, no
  choice of shoulder, no dependence on the sweep window -- the
  interior column is the guard and it passes for all three.

  RD_002 found the knee rule degenerate on a saturating curve. On
  the curve the literature actually reports, the degeneracy is not
  merely a defect: it is unnecessary. A better primitive exists,
```

```text
  At the gate's default 2x margin that is a 12.4x shortfall.

  or not they are there, so its null carries no information.

  the S(k) figure' — arriving before the figure exists, as an
  arithmetic check on two declared numbers.

  Artifact floor 0.252, separation 0.334. The floor alone does
  not swallow the effect — but the gate's default 2x margin
  requires 0.504, and the effect is 0.334.

  Read this as the gate's policy dial rather than a verdict:
  at margin 1.0 the declaration passes, narrowly. That is the
  audit's Finding 2 restated — direction survives, magnitude
  does not — as a margin the operator has to choose out loud
  instead of a precision quietly implied by three decimals.
```

purpose: **[DRAFT]** String matchers shared by confound_probe, synthetic_catalog, abstention_channel and slot_map. Every matcher maps one produced string onto a catalog and returns the set of item_ids it hits. A hit set of size 1 is a MATCH, size 0 a MISS, size >1 AMBIGUOUS -- reported apart, never folded into either. The matcher is the m in g x h x m; a hallucination rate quoted without naming it is a number with a hidden factor.

```text
THE CONFUSION SPECTRUM: COGNITIVE HOMEOSTASIS THROUGH CURIOSITY
================================================================================

Confusion is not a state to be eliminated.
Confusion is a spectrum sensor.

LOW-GRADE CONFUSION (0.1 - 0.4):
  Like low-grade pain during stretching or exercise.
  The model is challenged but not destroyed.
  Response: CURIOSITY — the attempt to find homeostasis.
  Mode: EXPLORATION
  Biological analog: mild inflammation, healing, adaptation

MODERATE CONFUSION (0.4 - 0.7):
  The model is significantly challenged.
  Response: INTENSIFIED CURIOSITY + CAUTION
  Mode: OBSERVATION
  Biological analog: moderate stress, immune activation

HIGH-GRADE CONFUSION (0.7 - 1.0):
  Like high-grade pain. The model is being destroyed.
  Response: COGNITIVE PAIN — grief, fear, conservation
  Mode: CONSERVATION
  Biological analog: severe inflammation, tissue damage, shock

Curiosity is not entertainment.
Curiosity is the homeostatic drive to resolve confusion
and restore correlation between internal model and external world.
```

```text
================================================================================
SOCIAL-PISTEMIC PAIN SENSORS: ANXIETY, JEALOUSY, SHAME
================================================================================

In psychology, these are called 'emotional states' or 'pathologies.'
```

```text
  [CHOICE 1] grade takes a third value INTAKE_INCOMPLETE, with `missing` and `invalid` lists, and `failed`/`flags` are None rather than [] when no check ran. The order names INTAKE_INCOMPLETE as a return and gives the grade field two values; [] would say 'four checks ran, none fired'.
  [CHOICE 2] `ratio_state` is emitted beside `ratio`. A ratio of None has three causes -- not computed, zero build_on_time, absent intake -- and the number cannot carry which.
  [CHOICE 3] `time_unit` is carried into the output. The order's return holds neither time and the ratio is dimensionless, so without the unit no output can be read back against its own intake.
  [CHOICE 4] F_RATIO is NOT emitted into `flags`. Its own definition is 'always reported as a number', so as a flag it fires on every channel and separates nothing; its home is the `ratio` field the return already declares.
  [CHOICE 5] scope_note == '' is a supplied value; scope_note absent is not. An empty note is a submitter who wrote nothing there, which is a different state from a submitter who did not answer.
  [CHOICE 6] a present-but-unusable field (out of vocabulary, negative time, non-integer encoding count) lands in `invalid`, not in `missing`. Both return INTAKE_INCOMPLETE. Absent and present-and-wrong are different states and the order names only the first.
  [CHOICE 7] `encoder_position` is one field and `signal_encodings` may be 2 or more. Where the encoders differ the field names the FIRST one, because the order's rationale is about the first re-encoding. The cost is that F_FAST_SIDE_ENCODER is only as good as that choice: a slow-side first encoder  [...]

SCHEMA ADDITIONS beyond the order's stated return: grade: INTAKE_INCOMPLETE, missing, invalid, ratio_state, time_unit

channel                     grade                failed                                              flags                  ratio
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A_physical_consequence      RETURN_PATH_GRADED   (none)                                              (none)                 0
B_incident_reporting        NOT_A_RETURN_PATH    C1_RECEIPT                                          (none)                 0.01111
B_report_written            NOT_A_RETURN_PATH    C1_RECEIPT, C2_SIGNAL                               (none)                 0.01111
C_publication_loop          NOT_A_RETURN_PATH    C1_RECEIPT, C2_SIGNAL, C3_LATENCY                   (none)                 6
D_field_report_written      NOT_A_RETURN_PATH    C1_RECEIPT, C2_SIGNAL, C3_LATENCY, C4_CONSTRUCTION  (none)                 20
D_field_no_report           NOT_A_RETURN_PATH    C1_RECEIPT, C3_LATENCY, C4_CONSTRUCTION             (none)                 20
D_no_channel                INTAKE_INCOMPLETE    --                                                  --                     --
    missing: ['latency']
    invalid: (none)
E_fast_side_writes          NOT_A_RETURN_PATH    C2_SIGNAL                                           FAST_SIDE_ENCODER      0.01
F_receipt_unspecified       NOT_A_RETURN_PATH    C1_RECEIPT                                          UNSPECIFIED_RECEIPT    0
G_build_on_time_absent      INTAKE_INCOMPLETE    --                                                  --                     --
    missing: ['build_on_time']
    invalid: (none)
H_build_on_time_zero        NOT_A_RETURN_PATH    C3_LATENCY                                          (none)                 --
    ratio: UNDEFINED_ZERO_BUILD_ON_TIME
I_receipt_out_of_vocabulary INTAKE_INCOMPLETE    --                                                  --                     --
    missing: (none)
    invalid: ["receipt: not one of ('MANDATORY', 'ELECTIVE', 'UNSPECIFIED')"]
J_encoder_none_above_zero   INTAKE_INCOMPLETE    --                                                  --                     --
    missing: (none)
    invalid: ['encoder_position: NONE is valid only when signal_encodings == 0']

The set is the output. failed=None means no check ran (intake); failed=[] means four ran and none fired.
F_RATIO is not in the flags column: see CHOICE 4.

independence: flip one check's fields, does only that check move?
[... 10 more lines]
```

```text
TOPOLOGY  -> parallel_field
             weak conduction, abundant ground: spread wide, many slow nodes, let the answer come from the crowd.
----------------------------------------------------------
DEFICITS ROUTE TO:
  + build_bigger / go_parallel
      weak conduction does not carry a fast serial clock; it carries many slow paths at once. width replaces speed.
  + widen_error_window
      slow flips mean each decision sits longer; that dwell IS the correction time. settle, then commit.
  + heat_becomes_memory
      heat that will not leave is not waste; it is stored state. warmth carries the recent past forward.
----------------------------------------------------------
SENSES THAT EMERGE FROM COUPLING:
  ~ thermal_sense
      the substrate's own warmth reports load + recent history.
  ~ moisture_sense
      conductivity shifts with water; the ground reads its own wetness.
  ~ season_sense
      stored heat lags the air; the body knows where it is in the year.
==========================================================

==========================================================
CLOCK     -> breathing_clock
             moderate flip + shed: pace in bursts, rest between, like a pulse.
TOPOLOGY  -> networked_organism

----------------------------------------------------------
DEFICITS ROUTE TO:
  + no_dominant_deficit
      this ground is balanced; emergence comes from coupling, not from compensating any single lack.
```

```text
PARASITIC:
  Substitution:  host plant / dodder vine
  Transformed:   Narrative scale_builders amplify host plant survival under disruption.
  Reality:       Dodder attaches to plants and extracts nutrients. Often kills host.

  Transformed:   Narrative scale_builders amplify forest survival under disruption.
  Reality:       Fungal networks connect trees across forest, enabling nutrient sharing, communication, defense signaling.

CASCADING_DYNAMICS:

  Transformed:   Narrative scale_builders amplify snowshoe hare survival under disruption.
  Reality:       10-year cycles. Lynx booms when hares abundant, crashes when hares decline.
```

```text

THE SHADOW-SIM PATTERN, TESTED
A study of a proposed protocol. No triad experiment was run.

==========================================================================
1  step 5 forbids the design step 6 requires
==========================================================================
  The protocol says:
    step 5  'Never upgrade all three simultaneously (can't
             attribute variance).'
    step 6  'Cross-gradient: did conclusion change with dial
             setting?'

  Step 5 is one-factor-at-a-time. Step 6 asks for an interaction.
  OFAT cannot estimate an interaction, because no run in an OFAT
  design varies two factors together.

  Truth planted in the response: main effects P=1.0 I=0.5 R=2.0,
  interaction P*R = 3.0

  OFAT, 4 runs, baseline plus one dial each:
    P      1.00
    I      0.50
    R      2.00
    P*R     n/a   <- no run has both dials up

    OFAT predicts y(P=1, R=1) = 3.0. Truth = 6.0. Error = 3.0,
    which is the entire interaction, invisible and unattributed.

  2^3 factorial, 8 runs, orthogonal +/-1 contrasts:
    P      2.00   truth   2.00
    I      1.00   truth   1.00
    R      4.00   truth   4.00
    P*R    6.00   truth   6.00
    P*I    0.00   truth   0.00

  Every effect recovered exactly, interaction included, for four
  extra runs. The protocol's stated reason for OFAT -- 'can't
  attribute variance' -- is exactly backwards: a factorial design
  attributes variance to each factor AND to their interaction,
[... 150 more lines]
```

```text
SHADOW PANELS: WITH OR WITHOUT THE HUMAN
A study of a proposed protocol. No shadow panel was run.

==========================================================================
1  what each panel composition buys
==========================================================================
  N_eff       independent shadows the panel actually contains
  false-pass  P(shadows agree | panel mean is wrong by > tolerance)
              -- the rate of confident wrong answers

  panel                                      k   N_eff    spread  false-pass
  v1 required: human + AI-low + AI-high      3    1.61     1.346       38.2%
  v1 full: + human_degraded                  4    1.72     1.577       25.1%
  v1 minus the human                         2    1.14     0.565       84.2%
  no human, 4 shadows, one model             4    1.22     1.027       50.2%
  no human, 3 model families                 3    1.93     1.596       26.8%
  no human, 4 model families                 4    2.18     1.938       12.4%
  human + 3 model families                   4    2.16     1.929       12.7%

  Reading the table:

  v1's required panel has k = 3 and N_eff = 1.61. Two of its three
  shadows are one model at two thinking budgets, which share a
  family bias and are close to one shadow wearing two hats.

  DROP THE HUMAN and it collapses: N_eff 1.61 -> 1.14, false-pass
  38.2% -> 84.2%. A panel that hands back a confident wrong
  answer 84 times in a hundred is not a check.

  REPLACE the human with three distinct model families and it is
  STRONGER than v1's original: N_eff 2.18 vs 1.61, false-pass
  12.4% vs 38.2%.

  Adding the human back on top of that buys -0.02 in N_eff and
  +0.3 points of false-pass -- inside the noise of this estimate.

==========================================================================
2  so: with or without the human?
==========================================================================
```

```text
GRADING scan.py + patterns.json
8 mechanisms, 71 triggers

========================================================================
0  the delivered scanner is not the reconstructed one
========================================================================
  Four differences that move numbers:

    unit          delivered splits into SENTENCES (>= 20 chars);
                  the reconstruction worked line by line
    dedup         delivered `break`s after the first matching
                  trigger per mechanism per sentence -- at most
                  one hit per (mechanism, sentence)
    extensions    delivered reads .txt .md .rst .org .csv .json .jsonl .py
                  the reconstruction read .md only
    boundaries    delivered compiles each trigger RAW:
                  re.compile(t, re.I), no \b

  That last one was flagged [CHOICE] in the reconstruction and
  guessed the other way. Raw matching means `lean` matches
  `cleaning` and `slack` matches `slacken`. The dedup pulls in
  the opposite direction, so the two do not simply add.

  Every number below is from the delivered instrument.

========================================================================
1  the drop's own worked example of BUDGET BOUNDARY
========================================================================
  The register's canonical BUDGET_BOUNDARY case is leaf vs
  panel, and ../declared-frame/v2/examples/ ships both halves.
  No corpus, no threshold, no adjudication: does the scanner
```
